_doc: Look and layout scale shared by the generator, the 3D renderer and the human-view bot (Doug, BACKLOG-R4 batch 3). buildScale multiplies the footprints of sink/conv/struct/food nodes in the generator and the models in the renderer, so a change is one edit plus a pack rebuild. charScale draws every character larger (the over-head labels and bars rise with it); textScale multiplies units.ts TEXT. viewW is the ground width across the screen in world units at the look point, by level family (default when a family is not listed); the bot's view box is viewW x groundK (the mean of the wider ground toward the top edge). modelBrightness multiplies the colour of every loaded Meshy GLB model (1 = as authored; raise it if models look darker in game than in the source art). modelScale multiplies one building's size on top of buildScale (renderer models and generator footprints; key 'id' or 'id:level', a missing id is 1; the footprint takes the largest level). alignedScale is the size set matched by doorways to the kiosk (Doug, 2026-10-25: kiosk x1.37 so its roofline matches the three processors, its door-matched neighbours sized from its old fit; core L1 x2.35 as in the scale mockup, core L2/L3 at 1.25x/1.5x L1's height); the layout sandbox's Aligned sizes toggle shows it. Doug's sandbox values (2026-10-25) are locked: modelScale = alignedScale, buildScale 0.7, charScale 1.5, textScale 0.75, viewW 170. plotLayout (Doug's plot plan): on = each building's pads on fixed slots of its plot (content/data/plot.json, rebuilt by pnpm plots:build after any change here); pad = pad plate across in world units; plateK = a machine operator's plate across as a multiple of the player's width.
